2609.24322.title: The Undetected Damage of Quantization on Retrieval and How to Fix It
2609.24322.paper_summary: We show that a quantized model that keeps its classification accuracy still changes $14$ to $46\%$ of its top-1 retrieval results, and that aggregate ranking metrics reveal only part of this damage. We tie this failure to the gap between the two highest scores and use that gap to decide when a quantized answer can be trusted and where additional precision should be spent. We show that the top-1 result is guaranteed to survive quantization only when this gap exceeds twice the largest rounding error. In classification, scores are the logits, and the loss function pushes the correct class away from other classes, encouraging this gap. In retrieval, scores are query-document scores, and nothing separates the top-1 item from the second. This gap can be measured without labels. Before deployment, it predicts which models will break under quantization, and at deployment time it tells, per input, whether the quantized answer still matches the full-precision answer. Most classification inputs have a gap wide enough to trust the quantized answer, but few retrieval queries do. That gap motivates a different fix in each task. In retrieval, spending extra bit-width on the layers whose quantization moves the gap most recovers up to three-quarters of an extra bit's benefit for half its cost. In classification, routing the few low-gap inputs to full precision recovers most of the lost accuracy at a fraction of the cost.
2609.24322.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了一個量化模型，它在保持分類準確性的同時，仍然改變了 $14$% 到 $46\%$ 的 top-1 檢索結果，而聚合排名指標僅揭示了這一損害的一部分。我們將這一失敗與兩個最高分數之間的差距聯繫起來，並利用這一差距來決定何時可以信任量化答案，以及在哪裡應該花費額外的精度。當這一差距超過最大四捨五入誤差的兩倍時，我們展示了 top-1 結果在量化過程中能夠生存的保證。在分類中，分數是 logits，而損失函數則將正確類別推離其他類別，從而鼓勵這一差距。在檢索中，分數是查詢-文檔分數，並且沒有任何東西將 top-1 項目與第二項分開。這一差距可以在沒有標籤的情況下進行測量。在部署之前，它預測哪些模型會在量化過程中崩潰，而在部署時，它告訴每個輸入，量化答案是否仍然與全精度答案匹配。大多數分類輸入的差距足夠大，可以信任量化答案，但很少有檢索查詢如此。這一差距促使每個任務採取不同的修正。在檢索中，對那些量化移動差距最大的層花費額外的位寬，可以在其成本的一半內恢復多達三分之四的額外位的好處。在分類中，將少量低差距的輸入路由到全精度可以在成本的一小部分內恢復大部分損失的準確性。
